# Federated medicines Platinum products

Conductor track:
`conductor/tracks/federated_medicines_platinum_20260829/`

Deliver remote-first CLI, read-only API, accessible atlas, historical
comparisons, evidence-graph exploration, and deterministic research exports
over pinned public Hugging Face medallion revisions. No durable local data lake
is required; every response exposes provenance, revision, schema era, coverage,
freshness, confidence/review, and comparison validity.

Add reimbursement-atlas and donor-successor compatibility canaries so the
federated system has one mutable authority per contract rather than divergent
raw copies.

Requirements: M-111, M-112, S-005, S-006, S-014, C-011, W-011.
